//go:build !windows

package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"syscall"
)

func rejectPrivateReparsePath(path string) error {
	if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
		return errors.New("private fixture path must be absolute")
	}
	for current := filepath.Clean(path); ; current = filepath.Dir(current) {
		info, err := os.Lstat(current)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("private fixture path contains a symlink: %s", current)
		}
		if current == filepath.Dir(current) {
			return nil
		}
	}
}

func createPrivateDirectory(path string) error {
	if err := rejectPrivateReparsePath(filepath.Dir(path)); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := os.Mkdir(path, 0700); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return validatePrivateDirectory(path)
}

func validatePrivateDirectory(path string) error { return validatePrivateOtherPath(path, true) }
func validatePrivateFile(path string) error      { return validatePrivateOtherPath(path, false) }

func validatePrivateOtherPath(path string, directory bool) error {
	if err := rejectPrivateReparsePath(path); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	info, err := os.Lstat(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if info.IsDir() != directory || (!directory && !info.Mode().IsRegular()) {
		return errors.New("private fixture path has the wrong file type")
	}
	stat, ok := info.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
	if !ok || int(stat.Uid) != os.Geteuid() {
		return errors.New("private fixture owner differs from current user")
	}
	expected := os.FileMode(0600)
	if directory {
		expected = 0700
	}
	if info.Mode().Perm() != expected {
		return fmt.Errorf("private fixture mode is %04o; expected %04o", info.Mode().Perm(), expected)
	}
	return nil
}

func makePrivateFile(path string) error {
	if err := validatePrivateDirectory(filepath.Dir(path)); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := rejectPrivateReparsePath(path); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	info, err := os.Lstat(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	stat, ok := info.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
	if !ok || int(stat.Uid) != os.Geteuid() || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
		return errors.New("private fixture file must be regular and owned by current user")
	}
	if err := os.Chmod(path, 0600); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return validatePrivateFile(path)
}
